dialogues.speaker: Katari
dialogues.text: The sight of Hunza charging into battle... As fast as he used to speak.

dialogues.speaker: Katari
dialogues.text: It feels so long since I last heard him rambling on. Perhaps I'll never hear it again.

dialogues.speaker: Katari
dialogues.text: Sorry, I'm not in the mood for a chat... Don't think I'll be in the mood tomorrow, either.
